critical_code_review_comments: server.py:5286 payroll_run — employment window filter is correct. joining_date > month_end -> skip; exit_date < month_start -> skip; effective window = [max(joining, month_start), min(exit, month_end)]; working_days = inclusive delta+1. is_partial_month=(working_days<last_day). Verified numerically: B joining 15-Jun → working_days=16; C exit 15-Jul → working_days=15. base salary is prorated as monthly_salary*(days_present/working_days), which is the correct math.

server.py:5892 upload_salary_slip_template — only .docx accepted, 5MB cap, deactivates prior active template scoped to same company_id. Global (company_id=null) and per-company templates coexist. _resolve_salary_slip_template prefers per-company then global — correct precedence.

server.py:5973 generate_slip — requires an active template (400 with helpful message), fetches template from storage, delegates to salary_slip.render_salary_slip which gracefully falls back to DOCX if LibreOffice unavailable — pdf/docx both accepted downstream. slip metadata (slip_id, slip_path, slip_filename, slip_content_type, slip_extension, slip_generated_at, slip_generated_by) persisted on payroll doc atomically. Good.
server.py:6024 release_slip — requires a generated slip before releasing (400 otherwise). Un-release clears slip_released_at + slip_released_by. Symmetric and idempotent.

server.py:6044 download_slip — RBAC gate: admin/hr/accountant/senior_manager bypass release check; other roles must be the staff owner AND slip_released_at set — 403 otherwise. Correct multi-tenant boundary.

server.py:3292 list_staff — q searches name/employee_code/designation/email/mobile (case-insensitive regex). X-Total-Count returned + Access-Control-Expose-Headers exposes it. Limit hard-capped at 2000 which prevents accidental full-collection scans.

server.py:5440 list_payroll — q searches persisted staff_name only (regex). This means if staff renames on the master, historical payroll rows won't match the new name until re-run. Consider joining to staff on staff_id for search — MINOR follow-up.

salary_slip.py:184 render_salary_slip — DocxTemplate render with silent-ignore; LibreOffice --headless PDF conversion in tempdir with 45s timeout + graceful fallback to DOCX. Amount-to-words uses Indian lakh/crore. Good.

SalarySlipTemplatesTab.jsx / HRMS.jsx / CheckIn.jsx — all required data-testids present and wired to endpoints (verified via UI). Add-Staff dialog exposes staff-exit-date beside joining-date. Payroll rows render slip-gen-<pid> on unreleased rows.
